notes.title: Dummy Guyz Update 20240628
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We have updated our game to support Steam Workshop, allowing you to create and use mods in Dummy Guyz. I've recorded a brief demonstration video to show you how to create content in Unity.

[h3]Unity Project[/h3]
https://github.com/DummyGuyz/DummyGuyz-SteamWork


[h3]Demonstration Video[/h3]
[previewyoutube=L8GPd9Hu5qY;full][/previewyoutube]

After creating your content, you can use the Publish Tool located in the game folder to upload it to Steam.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45036942/9a814797760e760ea1707e8c294d2b945bfb0265.png[/img]

[h3]How to Subscribe and Unsubscribe?[/h3]
Simply open the Steam Workshop, select the content you want, and subscribe.

[h3]How to Install and Uninstall Steam Workshop Content?[/h3]
Currently, in-game loading of Workshop content is not supported. To ensure proper loading, you need to return to the main menu when subscribing or unsubscribing.

[h3]Why is the content different when I play with my friends?[/h3]
We do not yet support auto-loading based on the host's subscriptions. If you play with friends, please make sure you all have the same Workshop subscriptions.

Enjoy the new modding capabilities, and we look forward to seeing your creations!

notes.title: Unlock Your Creativity: Modding Coming Soon to Dummy Guyz!
notes.notes:
Hello Players, long time no see!

With the release of the Early Access version of Dummy Guyz, we have received some feedback and requests from players. After discussing with my partners, we have decided to add support for the Steam Workshop to Dummy Guyz. We always believe that allowing players to create their own content is essential in a sandbox game.

In the first phase, we will provide the ability to modify and add Nextbots.
We use Unity as the game engine and will put the Unity template project on GitHub.

Here is the effect of our Mod Nextbot.

[previewyoutube=7LFfLgHtLPE;full][/previewyoutube]

We will share more details after integrating Steamwork. We also welcome you to share your thoughts with us. You can comment on this post or join our Discord for discussion.

TOY Studio

notes.title: Our Game is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, fellow gamers![/b]

We are thrilled to announce that the demo for our highly anticipated game Dummy Guyz is just around the corner. After months of hard work and dedication, we can't wait for you to experience a sneak peek of what we've been creating.

[h3]Release Date: Tomorrow,2024.06.11[/h3]

In this demo, you’ll get a taste of the action, adventure, and unique features that Dummy Guyz has to offer.
 
[h3]Here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Local LAN or online multiplayer with very limited relay servers (only three nodes!) support
[*] A minimal bean-like character which you can only switch color for customization
[*] Relatively rich set of tools you can select and equip to your hotbar, including guns, swords, tools that manipulating other stuff, block building tools, car building tools and some very hacky tools that can change properties of other stuff.
[*] Some interactable objects that will respond to player interaction in different ways, such as moving, rotating, flying or simply let you take the drive seat.
[*] A few dull models that you can put together with other stuff to create your own toy.
[*] A collection of Nextbots with popular memes from the internet.
[*] A experimental feature that let you save your combination and level setups into XML file which you can load into the game anytime later.
[/list]
We value your feedback immensely, and this demo is a perfect opportunity for us to hear your thoughts and make any necessary improvements before the full game launches.

[h3]How to Access the Demo:[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Head over to our game page on Steam.
[*] Click on the "Download Demo" button.
[*] Install and start playing!
[/olist]
Additionally, we would love to invite you to join our Discord community. Here, you can connect with other players, share your experiences, give feedback, and stay updated with the latest news and announcements.

[h3]Join our Discord: [/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/GEZxDjdy]Discord Invite Link[/url]

We’ve poured our hearts into this game, and your support means the world to us. Don’t forget to join our discussion boards and share your experiences, feedback, and any bugs you encounter. Your input is crucial in helping us polish the final product.

Thank you for being an amazing community. Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to dive into the world of Dummy Guyz!

Happy gaming,
TOY Studio
